description: Observed while proving fz-6lf.2 telemetry: a single defmodule/public definition and an item macro emit repeated [fz, compiler2, macro, expanded] events when ScopeCode blocks and retries (public/1 expanded three times; make_answer/0 and enclosing defmodule likewise repeat). Goal: make one logical source macro invocation execute once per unchanged quoted input/product generation, retaining its expanded root across downstream waits so macros with compile-time effects are not replayed. Signal: an adjacent source-publication test deliberately forces downstream blocking and asserts one expansion event per macro call identity, then verifies invalidation re-executes exactly when an input or macro product changes. Investigate whether caching belongs in retained product state or ScopeSession without adding a second expansion authority.
title: Memoize item-macro expansion across blocked scope retries
